title: skills/objectstack-i18n: drop the "label serving reads inline text as defaultLocale text" caveat and eval case 11's fallbackLocale requirement once #33634 lands
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjrEpxMVxEiDUJHqC

This is the `Skills-docs:` follow-up of card #33634 / PR #34025. The PR's merge-delta contract review found it: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/34025#issuecomment-6898397912, should-fix S1.

**What changes when PR #34025 merges:** the five serving readers treat `i18n.sourceLocale` as the language of the inline label. With `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN', sourceLocale: 'en'` and no `fallbackLocale`, an `en` request is answered from the English inline label, and a `zh-CN` request walks the chain.

**What the published skill still says** (`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` on main, under the `i18n` key table, added by #33934 while #33634 was open):

> ⚠️ Label serving still reads inline text as `defaultLocale` text: with no `fallbackLocale: 'en'`, an `en` request reaches the zh-CN bundle before the English inline label.

`skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`, case 11, repeats that sentence in `expected_output` and has `fallbackLocale: 'en'` in `must_contain`.

**Ask:** once PR #34025 is merged, remove or rewrite the caveat so the skill says serving honours `sourceLocale`. Decide whether case 11 keeps `fallbackLocale: 'en'` as a required string. A declared `fallbackLocale: 'en'` beside `sourceLocale: 'en'` is harmless, but its stated reason becomes false. Keep the narrower remaining truth if you want it: validation and refusal messages still read labels through `t()` until #34030 lands.

Blocked-by: #33634 (PR #34025) — the text is true until that merges.
